name: Ashwend
author: dannie@birkhansen.tech
description: Dedicated server for Ashwend, a multiplayer survival game on Steam. Runs the official image and needs two UDP ports: the primary allocation is the game port, and a second allocation is Steam's query port. Set Steam Query Port to the second allocation's number; on a shared IP, 27016 is rarely this server's own. Without it the server runs but is not listed. Guide: https://github.com/Ashwend/ashwend-server/blob/main/docs/game-panels.md

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Ashwend server ships inside the ghcr.io/ashwend/ashwend-server image, so
# there is nothing to download. The world, the ban list and the logs are
# written to this server's folder on first start.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install: the Ashwend server ships in its image."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: Comma-separated SteamID64s allowed to use the in-game admin panel (the 17-digit number starting 7656119 on a Steam profile). Read at start.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The most players online at once. Admins bypass it. 0 means no limit.

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Steam's server browser queries the server on this UDP port. It must be one of this server's own allocations: add a second port (allocation) to the server and enter its number here. The default 27016 only works if 27016 is allocated to this server.

variables.name: VAC
variables.description: 1 runs with Valve Anti-Cheat, 0 without. Steam tickets and game ownership are checked either way.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional. Ties the server to a Steam account that owns the game (steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers, app ID 4985910). Not needed to be listed.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed of a new world. Empty picks one at random. Has no effect on a world that already exists.

variables.name: Wipe Cycle Days
variables.description: How many days of running time a new world lasts before it ends and a new one begins. Empty means 30, or the existing world's length. Changing it for an existing world stops the server from starting: start a new world instead.
